summary: This HTML file is the entry point for the frontend of the Events Management application. It sets up the basic structure of the page, including the document type, language, and metadata, and links to necessary stylesheets and scripts.
evidence: The <head> section contains meta tags for character set, favicon, viewport, and title, as well as links to CSS files and Google Fonts. The <body> section contains a <div> with the id 'root' and a script tag that references the main JavaScript file.
